{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders and remove QA orders
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
clean_df = completed_df[completed_df['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Parse revenue
clean_df['revenue'] = clean_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute conversion rate by channel
conversion_by_channel = clean_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
total_email_conversion = conversion_by_channel['email']
total_paid_search_conversion = conversion_by_channel['paid_search']

# Compute conversion rate by channel and customer_segment
stratified_conversion = clean_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(level='customer_segment')

# Extract conversion rates for each channel and segment
email_conversions = stratified_conversion.loc['email']
paid_search_conversions = stratified_conversion.loc['paid_search']

# Compute within-segment differences (email - paid_search)
within_segment_diff = email_conversions - paid_search_conversions

# Print all required values explicitly
print("Total email conversion rate (completed only):", total_email_conversion)
print("Total paid_search conversion rate (completed only):", total_paid_search_conversion)
print("Email conversion rate in loyal segment: ", email_conversions['loyal'])
print("Email conversion rate in new segment: ", email_conversions['new'])
print("Email conversion rate in returning segment: ", email_conversions['returning'])
print("Paid_search conversion rate in loyal segment: ", paid_search_conversions['loyal'])
print("Paid_search conversion rate in new segment: ", paid_search_conversions['new'])
print("Paid_search conversion rate in returning segment: ", paid_search_conversions['returning'])
print("Within-segment difference (email - paid_search) in loyal segment: ", within_segment_diff['loyal'])
print("Within-segment difference (email - paid_search) in new segment: ", within_segment_diff['new'])
print("Within-segment difference (email - paid_search) in returning segment: ", within_segment_diff['returning'])"}
